t: 尼卡埃亚第一会正式开幕,开始了基督教会的第一个普世会会.
te: The First Council of Nicaea is formally opened, starting the first ecumenical council of the Christian Church.
dz: 尼卡埃亚第一会正式开幕,开始了基督教会的第一个普世会会.
de: The First Council of Nicaea is formally opened, starting the first ecumenical council of the Christian Church.

t: 最初的Nicene Creed被尼卡亚第一议会通过.
te: The original Nicene Creed is adopted at the First Council of Nicaea.
dz: 最初的Nicene Creed被尼卡亚第一议会通过.
de: The original Nicene Creed is adopted at the First Council of Nicaea.
